File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Persist the user's selected export format in localStorage so that opening a report retains the previously chosen format instead of resetting to the default.
args.title: Persist export format choice in localStorage

args.body:
label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ExportButton initializes its format state from defaultFormat (defaulting to "csv") and does not remember the user's previously chosen format in localStorage, causing the dropdown to reset every time a report is opened.
